verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies retention control. Receipt rules can deliver inbound mail to the customer's own Amazon S3 bucket, optionally encrypted with KMS, so the customer governs that stored copy. A community comment also notes SES itself does not keep very detailed logs. Missing for 10: documented SES-side retention periods, explicit deletion controls or APIs for message and event data, suppression-list or contact data deletion, and any privacy or retention policy documentation.
